description: The sizes and limits of an Implementer environment (#818): the VM sizes a task may ask for and the bounds of its setup script. A data file: no schema, nothing refers to it. The Dispatcher (SANDBOX_VCPUS in dispatcher/src/launchers/sandbox.ts) and the app (app/src/implementer/environments/limits.ts) each keep a typed copy that a test compares with this file; a size the Dispatcher does not list is refused at the launch.
